system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: gke-cluster.jinja

resources:
- name: gke-cluster
  type: gke-cluster.jinja
  properties:
    cluster:
      name: prod-gke-cluster
      initialNodeCount: 1
      location: us-central1
      enableKubernetesAlpha: false
      enableTpu: false
      loggingService: logging.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      monitoringService: monitoring.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      network: projects/{{ env["project"] }}/global/networks/default
      subnetwork: projects/{{ env["project"] }}/regions/us-central1/subnetworks/default
      masterAuth:
        clientCertificateConfig:
          issueClientCertificate: false
      masterAuthorizedNetworksConfig:
        enabled: true
        cidrBlocks:
        - displayName: internal-network
          cidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      ipAllocationPolicy:
        useIpAliases: true
        createSubnetwork: false
      defaultMaxPodsConstraint:
        maxPodsPerNode: 110
      binaryAuthorization:
        evaluationMode: DISABLED
      autoscaling:
        enableNodeAutoprovisioning: false
      securityPostureConfig:
        mode: STANDARD
      networkConfig:
        datapathProvider: ADVANCED_DATAPATH
      addonsConfig:
        httpLoadBalancing:
          disabled: false
        horizontalPodAutoscaling:
          disabled: false
        kubernetesDashboard:
          disabled: true
        networkPolicyConfig:
          disabled: false
        cloudRunConfig:
          disabled: true
      nodePools:
      - name: prod-node-pool
        initialNodeCount: 3
        autoscaling:
          enabled: true
          minNodeCount: 3
          maxNodeCount: 10
        config:
          machineType: e2-standard-4
          diskSizeGb: 100
          diskType: pd-standard
          imageType: COS_CONTAINERD
          serviceAccount: default
          oauthScopes:
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform
          metadata:
            disable-legacy-endpoints: "true"
          tags:
          - gke-node
          - prod
          shieldedInstanceConfig:
            enableIntegrityMonitoring: true
            enableSecureBoot: true
          linuxNodeConfig:
            sysctls:
              net.core.somaxconn: "1024"
              net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout: "60"
        management:
          autoUpgrade: true
          autoRepair: true
        upgradeSettings:
          strategy: SURGE
          maxSurge: 1
          maxUnavailable: 0
      verticalPodAutoscaling:
        enabled: true
      privateClusterConfig:
        enablePrivateNodes: true
        enablePrivateEndpoint: false
        masterIpv4CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/28
      databaseEncryption:
        state: DECRYPTED
      workloadIdentityConfig:
        workloadPool: {{ env["project"] }}.svc.id.goog
      notificationConfig:
        pubsub:
          enabled: false

outputs:
- name: clusterName
  value: $(ref.gke-cluster.name)
- name: clusterEndpoint
  value: $(ref.gke-cluster.endpoint)
- name: clusterCaCertificate
  value: $(ref.gke-cluster.masterAuth.clusterCaCertificate)
- name: nodePoolName
  value: $(ref.gke-cluster.nodePools[0].name)
